contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Early Medieval silver primary phase, Series A3, Type 2a, sceatta. Obverse: Radiate bust right, TIC before broken A and annulet behind, curved exergual lines either side of a beaded line. Inscription: TIC before bust and an annulet either side of a broken 'A' behind bust. Reverse: Beaded standard containing TOT II, TUFA horns with symbol 'V' either side T's at angles and a cross below.…
